title: KAVACH — Risk Trend
description: Business risk over time — pulled straight from Postgres (scan_results/findings), not Prometheus: this is historical business data KAVACH already persists, not a metric worth duplicating into a time-series database with its own retention/cardinality trade-offs.

panels.title: Banking Risk Score trend (avg / max per day)

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', sr.created_at) AS time, AVG(sr.brs_score) AS avg_brs_score, MAX(sr.brs_score) AS max_brs_score FROM scan_results sr WHERE $__timeFilter(sr.created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', f.created_at) AS time, f.severity, COUNT(*) AS count FROM findings f WHERE $__timeFilter(f.created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT r.name AS repository, sr.brs_score, sr.brs_risk_level, sr.attack_surface_exposure_score, sr.created_at AS last_scanned FROM scan_results sr JOIN scan_jobs sj ON sr.scan_job_id = sj.id JOIN repositories r ON sj.repository_id = r.id WHERE sr.created_at = (SELECT MAX(sr2.created_at) FROM scan_results sr2 JOIN scan_jobs sj2 ON sr2.scan_job_id = sj2.id WHERE sj2.repository_id = r.id) ORDER BY sr.brs_score DESC

panels.title: Compliant-scan percentage by framework, per day
panels.description: compliance_summary (JSONB, one row per scan) records violations/compliant per framework, not a percentage — this computes 'percentage of scans with zero violations for this framework' per day from that boolean, which is what's actually stored (see app/services/compliance/compliance_mapper.py's get_compliance_summary()).

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', sr.created_at) AS time, framework.key AS framework, 100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN (framework.value->>'compliant')::boolean THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS compliant_scan_pct FROM scan_results sr, jsonb_each(sr.compliance_summary) AS framework WHERE $__timeFilter(sr.created_at) AND jsonb_typeof(framework.value) = 'object' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
